items.title: Bill Goodwin interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 28, 2025
items.q: Oh you know I knew Cannonball, he was a great man. A wonderful man.

ctx.x: I had a nice chat with him at the Deer Head Inn years ago. It was real fun for me. For one thing he had a good Cannonball Adderley story and all kinds of things like that.
Oh yeah. Oh you know I knew Cannonball, he was a great man. A wonderful man.
Among the other people that I was going to ask you about was Joe Williams.
